description: Retrieves checklists for a Trello card identified by ID or shortlink, with options to filter checklists and include their check items.

card_fields.description: Specifies the fields to return for associated card objects. Use 'all' for all fields (default), or provide a comma-separated list of desired fields. Available fields: 'badges', 'checkItemStates', 'closed', 'dateLastActivity', 'desc', 'descData', 'due', 'email', 'idAttachmentCover', 'idBoard', 'idChecklists', 'idLabels', 'idList', 'idMembers', 'idMembersVoted', 'idShort', 'labels', 'manualCoverAttachment', 'name', 'pos', 'shortLink', 'shortUrl', 'subscribed', 'url'.
card_fields.title: Card Fields

cards.description: Filters which cards' checklists are retrieved. Valid values: 'all' (all cards), 'closed' (closed cards), 'none' (no cards, default), 'open' (open cards), or 'visible' (cards visible to the user).
cards.title: Cards

checkItem_fields.description: Specifies the fields to return for each check item. Use 'all' for all fields, or provide a comma-separated list of desired fields (default is 'name,nameData,pos,state'). Available fields: 'name', 'nameData', 'pos', 'state', 'type'.
checkItem_fields.title: Check Item Fields

checkItems.description: Filters the check items to be returned within each checklist. Valid values: 'all' (default) or 'none'.
checkItems.title: Check Items

fields.description: Specifies the fields to return for each checklist. Use 'all' for all fields (default), or provide a comma-separated list of desired fields. Available fields: 'idBoard', 'idCard', 'name', 'pos'.
fields.title: Fields

filter.description: Filters which checklists are returned. Valid values: 'all' (default, returns all checklists) or 'none' (returns no checklists).
filter.title: Filter

idCard.description: The ID or shortlink of the Trello card.
idCard.title: Id Card

name: get_cards_checklists_by_id_card

due.description: Due date for the check item in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2022-11-26T02:00:00.000Z') or null if no due date is set
due.title: Due

dueReminder.description: Number of minutes before the due date when a reminder should be sent, or null if no reminder is set. Can be negative (e.g., -1 for reminders after due date)
dueReminder.title: Due Reminder

id.description: Unique identifier for the check item
id.title: Id

idChecklist.description: ID of the parent checklist containing this item
idChecklist.title: Id Checklist

idMember.description: ID of the member assigned to this check item, or null if unassigned
idMember.title: Id Member

name.description: Name or text of the check item
name.title: Name

nameData.description: Additional metadata about the check item name. Typically null
nameData.title: Name Data

pos.description: Position of the item within the checklist for ordering
pos.title: Pos

state.description: Completion state of the item. Values: 'complete' or 'incomplete'
state.title: State

disableAt.description: The maximum number of check items allowed before creation is disabled
disableAt.title: Disable At

warnAt.description: The threshold at which warnings should be shown
warnAt.title: Warn At

checkItems.description: Array of check items within this checklist
checkItems.title: Check Items

creationMethod.description: Method used to create the checklist, or null if default
creationMethod.title: Creation Method

id.description: Unique identifier for the checklist. Matches TrelloID pattern ^[0-9a-fA-F]{24}$
id.title: Id

idBoard.description: ID of the board containing this checklist
idBoard.title: Id Board

idCard.description: ID of the card containing this checklist
idCard.title: Id Card

limits.description: Limits information for the checklist including max check items
limits.title: Limits

pos.description: Position of the checklist for ordering
pos.title: Pos

checklists.description: Array of checklist objects associated with the card, each including its check items
checklists.title: Checklists
